en: That flashlight was a Flashback Light.

A light that restores memory is simply divine!
I bet Atua had a hand in its creation!
<CLT=cltMIND>Should I hang out with Angie for a while?

Then let us pray to Atua and thank Him for
restoring our memories!

<CLT=cltMIND>I spent some time watching
Angie pray to Atua...
<CLT=cltMIND>Angie and I grew a little closer today.
